IMPLEMENTED AND PUSHED: Gerrit change 1155, commit e78c86be1.

THE FIX IS ONE ROW — `"_llm_float": (2, "")` in `KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS` (gen_env_registry.py) — plus the
regenerated docs/env-vars.md, which gained the four previously-invisible variables:
REBAR_LLM_TEMPERATURE, REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_MAX_DOC_FREQ, REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_MIN_SHOULD_MATCH,
REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_CONF_THRESHOLD. Verified present in the committed doc, one occurrence each.

WHY THIS SHIPS A GUARD AND NOT JUST THE ROW. A helper missing from that table is not an error, it is
INVISIBLE: the AST scan walks past every call to it and the CI drift gate stays green. So a clean
`gen_env_registry.py --check` proves the doc AGREES with the generator, never that it is COMPLETE.
The row alone fixes today's four variables and leaves the next `_llm_*` resolver free to lose its own.

THE DURABLE TEST asserts that every `_llm_*` resolver in config.py taking an `env_name` parameter is
registered, AND that the recorded argument index equals the real position of that parameter. The
position half matters because a wrong index fails just as silently as a missing row: the scanner
reads the wrong argument, `_str_literal` returns None, and the read is filed under
"dynamically-constructed" — gone exactly as if unregistered.

Keyed on the `env_name` PARAMETER rather than the `_llm_` prefix, because the prefix over-matches:
`_llm_drain_mode(raw)` coerces an already-read string to an enum and reads no environment. A negative
control pins that it stays unregistered, so the guard cannot decay into "register everything starting
with _llm_" — which would make the scanner mis-file whatever sits at that argument index.

RED->GREEN: 3 of 4 tests failed first, each for the right reason — all four vars invisible to
`scan()`, all four absent from the committed doc, and `['_llm_float']` unregistered. The negative
control passed from the start, correctly. After the fix: 4 passed.

MUTATIONS, each restored: removing the row -> 2 fail; registering it at the WRONG position (1 instead
of 2) -> 2 fail. The second is the one that matters — it proves the position assertion has teeth
rather than being decoration next to the membership check.

PROCESS NOTE: no held-out implementation subagent. The fix is a single dict row whose value is
determined by the helper's signature, so there is no implementation space to over-fit and nothing for
a held-out set to defeat. I authored the full contract first, confirmed RED, implemented, and
mutation-checked. Stated plainly rather than quietly skipped.

GATES: make lint clean, make typecheck clean, and all five generator/parity gates clean with the tree
showing only the three intended files. 41 passed across test_llm_config_pointer.py,
test_env_registry_helper_coverage.py and test_model_classes.py.

NOT CLOSING until 1155 is Verified +1.
